zh-Hans.headline: 写下想法，自成篇章
zh-Hans.subheadline: 标题、清单、表格与链接，让想法自然成形。

zh-Hans.headline: 把思路画清楚
zh-Hans.subheadline: 用 Mermaid 表达流程与关系，修改文字就能更新图表。

zh-Hans.headline: 让推导清晰可读
zh-Hans.subheadline: LaTeX 公式融入正文，思路与推导写在一起。

zh-Hans.headline: 代码，也有好排版
zh-Hans.subheadline: 用语法高亮记录代码，让解释与实现留在同一篇。

zh-Hans.headline: 分门别类，也能串联
zh-Hans.subheadline: 文件夹管项目，层级标签串联跨项目的想法。

zh-Hans.headline: 按意思，找回线索
zh-Hans.subheadline: 用自己的话描述内容，在本机查找相关笔记。
zh-Hans.footnote: 支持中英文；加密笔记不参与语义索引。

zh-Hans.headline: 旧资料，新思路
zh-Hans.subheadline: 在本机把文档转成笔记，再用需要的格式分享成果。
zh-Hans.footnote: 支持含文本 PDF 与 Office 文档；复杂版式可能变化。

zh-Hans.headline: 多端改动，自动合并
zh-Hans.subheadline: 跨设备同时修改普通笔记，正文会自动合并。
zh-Hans.footnote: 需开启 iCloud 同步；加密笔记保留版本供恢复。

zh-Hans.headline: 让配色，也属于你
zh-Hans.subheadline: 自定义、导入与导出主题，把喜欢的配色分享出去。

zh-Hans.headline: 表格，直接动手改
zh-Hans.subheadline: 点进单元格就能编辑，按内容调整行列与对齐。

en-US.headline: Give your thoughts shape
en-US.subheadline: Headings, tasks, tables, and links bring structure to every idea.

en-US.headline: Draw ideas with words
en-US.subheadline: Map a process or relationship with editable Mermaid diagrams.

en-US.headline: Make room for math
en-US.subheadline: Keep LaTeX formulas and the thinking behind them together.

en-US.headline: Code with context
en-US.subheadline: Keep syntax-highlighted code and its explanation in the same note.

en-US.headline: A place. A connection.
en-US.subheadline: Folders hold projects. Nested tags connect ideas across them.

en-US.headline: Search beyond exact words
en-US.subheadline: Describe an idea in your own words to find related notes locally.
en-US.footnote: Chinese and English supported. Encrypted notes are excluded from semantic indexing.

en-US.headline: Bring your work along
en-US.subheadline: Turn documents into editable notes locally, then export the format you need.
en-US.footnote: Supports text-based PDFs and Office documents. Complex layouts may change.

en-US.headline: Your edits come together
en-US.subheadline: Concurrent edits to ordinary note text merge across your iCloud devices.
en-US.footnote: iCloud sync is optional. Encrypted notes keep versions for recovery.

en-US.headline: Make themes your own
en-US.subheadline: Customize, import, and export themes, then share the colors you love.

en-US.headline: Edit tables, cell by cell
en-US.subheadline: Edit cells directly, then adjust rows, columns, and alignment.

zh-Hans.subheadline: 挑选喜欢的主题，让文字、代码与表格一起换个样子。
